content.json:
# Azure Monitoring Operations Workbook

This workbook tracks application health, error rate, latency, and service-level trends using Log Analytics queries.

content.query:
ApplicationEvents_CL
| summarize EventCount=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Application Event Volume

content.query:
ApplicationEvents_CL
| where StatusCode_d >= 500
| summarize ErrorCount=count() by ServiceName_s
| render barchart
content.title: Errors by Service
